default: original scalar/v1 behavior, no successor import
standalone_entry: validate_message(raw_bytes, *, legacy, producer, context, now_ns, consumer=None, enable_interval=False, bounds=None)
time: exact uint63, ordered closed observation interval, upper<=now
validity: exclusive min(lower+max_age, source_deadline, dispatch_deadline, explicit previous if present)>now
overflow: reject checked additions, no wrapping or saturation
downstream_duration: full exact target duration must fit; refuse rather than truncate or renew
STOP: original zero target and null observation allowed; downstream deadline None, no positive lease
